verdict.rationale: Requesty ships a dedicated MCP Gateway that lets AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Roo Code, any MCP-compatible tool) register/connect MCP servers, explore their tools, and use them through a unified API, with server management, per-user auth keys, and analytics on MCP usage. This is first-party documentation only, with no independent/hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: independent verification of the MCP Gateway working end-to-end, and more detail on tool-calling mechanics once connected.
